newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads wider after mixed day.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads wider after mixed day.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads to other dollar bloc bonds finished wider on the day after a fairly mixed session, traders said.

An initial widening in the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread widened to around 106 basis points in early trading, but narrowed after the latest report on wages through enterprise bargaining agreements showed a moderation in growth.

However, there was resistance in pushing back the spread below 100 basis points, although trading was fairly light and partly reflected the closure of U.S. bond markets in Asia trading due to today's U.S. Thanksgiving Day.
